Hannah Li: Heads up  candidate Ethan Clarke (UK) just confirmed he cleared customs but border officer asked for a company invitation letter for his records. He arrives at 09:40, original loop 10:30. Can people-ops produce a stamped letter quickly?
Owen Park: I can draft and print a stamped letter now. Hannah, which name exactly should appear and do we need a specific visa type mentioned?
Hannah Li: Use full name 'Ethan James Clarke' and mention 'onsite interview - temporary business visit, 1 day'. He said the officer wanted a company contact phone number too.
Zara Ahmed: Facilities: will reserve Quiet Room G 09:15-13:00 and prep guest pass. Need to know if Ethan requires accessible seating.
Hannah Li: No accessibility flags. Also request a Mac charger and a USB-C adapter as backup.
Marta Silva: Finance: if Ethan pays taxi or gets any incidental expense, he can submit via Expenses (Concur) under code "Candidate Travel". For foreign currency, we reimburse at bank rate same day. If he loses a receipt, we need a short explanation email + photo of card transaction.
Reception Bot: Note: Guest badges require ID. If border asks for additional documents we can print a signed letter and provide on arrival.
Travel Bot: Itinerary confirmed: flight BA283, landing 09:40 SFO. Transfer ETA ~10:10 if he takes taxi. Shuttle not available.
Hannah Li: Owen - can you include our HR phone + security desk in the letter (415-555-0199) and sign? I'll DM you the official template.
Owen Park: Draft ready and signed. Printed 1 copy and scanned to Hannah. I'll leave the signed original at reception.
Hannah Li: Thanks. Marta - quick Q: candidate asked if we can prepay a taxi voucher if customs delay leads to missed connection. Is that allowed?
Marta Silva: We can issue a one-way taxi voucher up to $75 if flights cause schedule changes, but requires pre-approval via expense@redwood.ai. Best to capture estimate first.
Hannah Li: I'll keep it as fallback. For now, panels shift to 11:00 start (shorten to 35m) to allow buffer. Zara, can you confirm parking QR and badge pickup?
Zara Ahmed: Parking spot P1 reserved, QR code queued to Hannah DM. Badge will be printed on arrival; I'll set pickup code 4472 as backup. Quiet Room G set and Mac charger + USB-C adapter left in locker 5, labelled.
Recruiter Bot: Candidate dietary note: lactose-free + vegetarian. Logged and added to calendar. Resume & portfolio re-sent to panelists. Remote fallback link included: https://meet.redwood.ai/onsite-fallback
Hannah Li: Also prepping a short note for border in the letter: "Candidate is visiting for interviews scheduled at Redwood Inference, 1 day. Employer contact: Hannah Li, Recruiter, +1 415-555-0123."
Owen Park: Updated letter printed and placed with Reception. Reception Bot: Received signed invitation letter, will hand to Ethan on arrival.
Marta Silva: If he needs a voucher, Hannah DM me amount + receipt after. If he pays by card we can reimburse within 3 business days.
Reception Bot: Candidate ETA updated to 10:05 at reception (cleared quicker than expected). Please check in 10 minutes before arrival to avoid queue.
Hannah Li: I've messaged Ethan with new 11:00 start time and given the fallback link and instructions to present the invitation letter at border if asked. He replied: "Thanks, I have the scanned letter and will bring ID. See you soon."
Zara Ahmed: Mac charger dropped off at reception at 09:45. Parking QR sent to Hannah DM. Quiet Room G prepared with HDMI and sticky note: `WiFi: Redwood-Guest | PW: visit2026`.
Marta Silva: Also logged tariff note for international per-diem policy in the expense ticket for quick reference.
Owen Park: All set from my side. Closing thread 44d"
